Name: Giant Crop Tweaks
Author: KhloeLeclair
Description:
Giant Crop Tweaks is a mod that adds additional behaviors to giant crops, including support for colored giant crops, preserving tilled soil under giant crops, and allowing regrowable crops to regrow after growing into a giant crop.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
You don't have to do anything. Giant crops will just work differently with this mod installed.

This mod does not include any new crops by itself, but it does automatically make other crops work differently. Mod authors may also use it to add colored giant crops.

If you run into problems, or think the mod isn't doing what it should be, please drop me a comment (and maybe include your log by uploading it to [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]).

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.4+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Does not work on Android
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]None for now. Let me know what you find!
[/list]
